Request Payment Via STK Push.description: Sends an M-Pesa PIN prompt to a customer phone to collect a payment.

Register C2B Callback URLs.description: Registers validation and confirmation URLs so paybill payments are pushed to your system.

Pay Supplier Till.description: Pays a supplier till number from your shortcode (B2B buy goods).

Remit Tax To KRA.description: Pays tax owed to the Kenya Revenue Authority from your shortcode.

Request STK Push For Each Member.description: Sends a payment prompt to every member in a list.

Custom Daraja Request.description: Makes a raw request to any Daraja endpoint with authentication handled for you.

Check Transaction Status.description: Queries the status of an M-Pesa transaction by its receipt number.
